experiments.title: Agent retrieval comparisons
experiments.question: Did prepared code context improve task correctness or execution cost?
experiments.conclusion: Retained runs include a narrow positive condition-level comparison and its earlier and negative comparisons.
experiments.limitations: Historical model and product versions. The packet treatment does not isolate retrieval alone; no current or general product claim follows.

experiments.title: Temporal memory and history delivery
experiments.question: Did prior project history help recover hidden decisions, and did delivery affect results?
experiments.conclusion: The archive preserves diagnostic pilots, invalid delivery runs, corrected comparisons, and the scoped clean history result.
experiments.limitations: Small samples, exclusions, and different delivery methods limit interpretation. Checkpoint content and private source state are not bundled.

experiments.title: Distillation scheduling
experiments.question: Did parallel extraction reduce elapsed time in local command-agent experiments?
experiments.conclusion: Retained audits report scheduling improvements for the recorded local and larger-repository workloads.
experiments.limitations: Local command-agent scheduling measurements do not establish hosted-model latency or current-product performance. Retired Python agents are not restored.

experiments.title: Packet formats and brief profiling
experiments.question: Could context serialization reduce size while preserving represented information?
experiments.conclusion: The archive preserves compact-packet measurements, A/B designs, and the frozen profile corpus identity.
experiments.limitations: Development measurements are not agent-quality evidence. The 114-task profile identity snapshot does not include the complete prompt corpus or a current runnable harness.

experiments.title: Release controls and negative comparisons
experiments.question: Which candidate release claims had sufficient evidence?
experiments.conclusion: The retained release comparisons and facts-versus-raw audit retain their no-release-claim limitations; tool-contract checks are separate.
experiments.limitations: Passing a historical contract or audit is not evidence of agent performance. Superseded MCP and Radar behavior remains historical.

experiments.title: Confirmatory planning and blocked decisions
experiments.question: Were the experiment design, engine checks, and statistical power sufficient for confirmation?
experiments.conclusion: The archive preserves the no-go decision, power analysis, engine-readiness reports, and the blocked ranking-change decision.
experiments.limitations: Planning and readiness records are not completed confirmatory outcomes. Large task inventories, relevance corpora, and private attestation inputs remain omitted.

experiments.title: Exploratory analysis records
experiments.question: What could be learned from earlier retained runs before a complete confirmatory protocol?
experiments.conclusion: Exploratory recomputations and ranking diagnostics remain labeled as exploratory.
experiments.limitations: Some original source suites and synthetic analyzer inputs are not archived. These reports cannot establish confirmatory claims.
